annotation.summary_en: GOV.UK 'About us' page for the UK Office for Artificial Intelligence, now merged into DSIT's AI Policy Directorate. It describes the Office's former responsibility for implementing the National AI Strategy across three pillars: long-term ecosystem investment, AI-enabled economy transition, and national and international AI governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Office for AI is now part of DSIT's AI Policy Directorate and no longer separately branded
It oversaw implementation of the National AI Strategy
Three pillars: ecosystem investment, AI-enabled economy, getting AI governance right
Points to the government response to the AI white paper consultation
